project_type: Two repos. Backend: .NET 10 microservices solution (Finnova.Backend.slnx) with UA host, SystemAdmin host, API gateway. Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + MUI + Vite SPA.
build_system: Backend: dotnet / MSBuild via Finnova.Backend.slnx. EF Core migrations use Finnova.SystemAdminService as startup project. Frontend: Vite + tsc.
test_framework: Backend: xUnit + Moq + FsCheck.Xunit + Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing (Finnova.Tests). Frontend: Vitest + React Testing Library + jsdom.
build_command: Backend: `dotnet build Finnova.Backend.slnx` (cwd d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API). Frontend: `npm run build` (cwd D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI).
test_command: Backend: `dotnet test Finnova.Tests/Finnova.Tests.csproj` (cwd d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API). Frontend: `npm test -- --run` (cwd D:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-UI).
verification_instructions: FEAT-001: build the backend solution, run dotnet test (new handler unit tests must pass), and generate the EF migration WITHOUT applying it (no `dotnet ef database update`). FEAT-002: `npm run build` then `npm test -- --run`. Verify cross-repo camelCase parity: backend JSON {isAdmin, programs:[{programName,canAdd,canModify,canQuery,canDelete}]} must match the UI MyPermissions/ScreenPermission field names.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The EF migration is generated code checked into Finnova.Repository/Migrations (plus FinnovaDbContextModelSnapshot.cs update). Command: `dotnet ef migrations add AddScreenProgramsAndPermissions --project Finnova.Repository/Finnova.Repository.csproj --startup-project Finnova.SystemAdminService/Finnova.SystemAdminService.csproj`. Do NOT run database update. Frontend tsconfig.tsbuildinfo may update on build.
environment_constraints: Backend MUST be built DIRECTLY in d:\Projects\Finnova\Finnova-API on branch feature/FINNOVA-10-user-management, which has UNCOMMITTED user-identity refactor changes (user_accounts is the single user+login table; migration 20261004161229_UnifyUserIdentity is untracked). Do NOT create a backend worktree. Frontend works on its current branch 'main' (also has uncommitted/staged work). Do NOT commit, rebase, or merge in either repo. Do NOT run `dotnet ef database update`. Use ABSOLUTE paths for both repos; relative paths land in the wrong repo.
contribution_requirements: Follow product-context steering: India-only, English only, no RTL, no bilingual fields (single plain Value fields). Follow existing MediatR/EF/service patterns. Tests ship with the feature.
key_patterns: Backend: EF config via IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> in Finnova.Repository/Configuration (ToTable, HasIndex().IsUnique(), HasData with deterministic GUIDs + fixed `new DateTime(2024,1,1,0,0,0,DateTimeKind.Utc)`); DbContext uses ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly so only a DbSet is added. MediatR handlers mirror LoginCommandHandler (inject IUserManagementRepository). TokenService already emits ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier=user.Id and a second ClaimTypes.Role='SystemAdmin' for Admin users. SystemAdminService/Program.cs has the JwtBearer template to mirror into UA. Frontend: service feature = interfaces/<f>.interface.ts + real/<f>.real.ts + mock/<f>.mock.ts + <f>.service.ts (toggle on import.meta.env.VITE_USE_MOCK_API) + barrels (services/index.ts, services/interfaces/index.ts, models/index.ts). Shared axios src/services/api.ts injects Bearer and centrally handles 401/403. Provider tree is in src/App.tsx (ThemeProvider>AuthProvider>NotificationProvider>BrowserRouter), NOT main.tsx. Master pages own the Add button (disabled={!canQuery} today); grid components own Edit/Delete icon buttons (LookupGrid disables by isSystemLocked); forms own the Save button. Vitest config in vite.config.ts, setup src/test/setup.ts; page tests mock the services barrel and use MemoryRouter.
